records.supported_name_scope: The complete generalized source polygon corresponds to Deschambault Lake on the WSA map. This supports a generalized waterbody identity, not an exact shoreline or scalar-name approval.
correspondence_observations: Full-outline comparison links the broad southern basin, west-projecting shoulder, narrow central connection and northeast arm to the single mapped Deschambault waterbody.
Wapawekka Lake lies west, Jan Lake east, and the Ballantyne River reaches the southwestern basin; these provide named map context beyond label proximity.
The124-position generalized ring omits islands, narrow northern bays and an eastern south-pointing spur shown on the map. Jan Lake is separately mapped and is not included in this identification.
